documents.notes: 'International Students' (freshman) and 'Transcript Info'. Major-specific items 'may be required' by the first- and second-choice majors; none is drafted. The page's decision dates are for the cycle releasing decisions in 2027; the materials list states no academic year.

items.quote: Apply using the Common App for summer/fall admission.
Submit at least one essay and the required short answer prompts.
Send at least one official SAT or ACT score directly from the testing agency
Submit transcripts showing that you have completed (or are in progress to complete) an accredited secondary school series equivalent to that of US grade 9-12.
If applicable, submit either an official Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL), International English Language Testing System (IELTS) or Duolingo English Test (DET).
items.condition: if applicable (the page's 'Info for International' criteria)

items.quote: If the documents you are submitting are written in a language other than English, you must also submit complete and official English translations together with the original language records.
items.condition: the documents are written in a language other than English

items.quote: You may submit a resume offering additional information about your achievements, activities, leadership positions and student employment.
You can submit up to two letters of recommendation.
